suppress.notes: False positive. Spring Boot's netty integration module (spring-boot-netty, versioned like Boot, e.g. 4.0.8) is matched to netty's CPE as if it were netty 4.0.8, which pulls in CVEs from 2014-2019. Real netty is netty-*-4.2.x and is scanned separately; this suppression deliberately matches only the spring-boot-netty jar, not other netty jars.
False positive. CVE-2018-1258 affects Spring Framework 5.0.5 only; it is matched to the spring-security-* jars (core, web, ...) by version number. Scoped to this one CVE.

False positive. CVE-2022-29631 is CRLF injection in Jodd HTTP (jodd-http <= 6.0.9). The jodd-core and jodd-bean jars here (via Redisson) contain no jodd/http classes; they are matched to the jodd product CPE, and which of the two gets the match varies between runs. Scoped to this one CVE on those two jars.

CVE-2026-65898 (DOMPurify < 3.4.11 bundled in swagger-ui). Exploiting it needs an attacker-registered uponSanitizeAttribute hook, which swagger-ui does not expose, so it is not reachable. Fix by bumping springdoc (follow-up); expires so it gets re-triaged.
